meta.name: modern_hellenist_invasion
meta.prompt: A modern Hellenist city being invaded by sea monsters.

character.label: modern hellenist coastal metropolis under sea siege

programs.brief: A colossal multi-tentacled sea leviathan rising violently from the ocean bay, gaping maw and grasping tentacles looming over the city waterfront, textured in dark abyssal scales.
A titanic horned sea serpent coiling out of the ocean waves, bioluminescent fin crest along its spine, striking toward the harbour edge.
An armored bipedal amphibious monster emerging from the surf with dorsal spines, webbed claws, and menacing jaws.

tokens.event_direction: colossal sea monsters surge from the ocean waters attacking the harbour and waterfront boulevards
tokens.infra: barricade_line sealing the coastal avenues; military_cordon across the harbour front
tokens.terrain: a grand coastal metropolis with a wide harbour overlooking deep open waters
tokens.icons: sea monsters breaching the bay water; neoclassical stoas and modern colonnaded avenues; fortified waterfront defenses; emergency barricades along the boardwalk
